nodes.label: ADR-012 Proposal integrity and enumeration hardening
nodes.summary: Accepted MVP decision dated 2026-08-24: revision-aware ticket uniqueness, parent-row locked attachment quotas, generic 404 downloads, stale-artifact rejection and two-layer resume rate limiting.
nodes.rationale: Revision ticket families, parallel uploads and public downloads require consistent integrity and non-enumerating access boundaries.
nodes.evidence_scope: Documented product/architecture decision; does not independently verify current code

nodes.label: Revision-aware ticket uniqueness
nodes.summary: Index ticket_number and unique(ticket_number, revision_number); revision 0 tickets unique while revision family shares ticket.
nodes.rationale: Maintain primary ticket identity without blocking linked revisions.

nodes.label: Parent-row locked attachment mutation
nodes.summary: Store/replace/delete lock parent proposal row before recounting chapter quota in transaction.
nodes.rationale: Concurrent uploads must not exceed shared file/size limits.

nodes.label: Non-enumerating fresh artifact downloads
nodes.summary: Unauthorized, stale payload/manifest and inactive chapter artifacts yield generic 404; resume throttled on pair+IP and whole IP.
nodes.rationale: Remove existence oracle and prevent stale documents being downloaded as current output.

nodes.label: Locked proposal model transition guard
nodes.summary: Locked proposals cannot reopen draft, delete or mutate except controlled submitted to needs_revision; reclamation choice explicit.
nodes.rationale: Preserve immutable submission even for direct model updates.
